hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

protocol.reduction: package method defaults; no HPO; eager backend
protocol.rate_denominator: labeled training nodes; NOPE reports actual retained nodes
protocol.parity: author SGNK eager versus native CUDA kernel capture; GP/Adam eager
protocol.failure_policy: terminal failures retained; no partial numeric cells
protocol.precision: float32; CGC reconstruction solve float64 as in package
protocol.settings: original package trans/ind settings; new datasets transductive
protocol.comparison_scope: new source/budgets only; no pooling of historical batches

statistics.accuracy: mean and population standard deviation across all 30 evaluations per reduced cell; full graph has 10 evaluations
statistics.reduction_time: median of three timing.reduction_seconds values; includes reduction and reduced-graph saving; data loading and downstream GCN fits are timed separately
statistics.paired_time: median 200-update loop time, plus median graph setup time for CUDA Graph; includes sampling, GP solve and Adam; graph preprocessing and GCN evaluation are timed outside this loop
